promise.bio: Toronto rapper, singer and songwriter Promise makes hip-hop soul shaped by reflective lyricism, faith, collaboration and a long-running independent career that includes the duo Perfeck Strangers.

prozzak.bio: Toronto virtual pop duo Prozzäk, created by Jay Levine and James Bryan McCollum of The Philosopher Kings, pairs dance-pop hooks with animated alter egos Simon and Milo.

pup.bio: Toronto punk band PUP combines aggressive energy, sharp hooks and dark humour in a relentlessly touring catalogue that grew from the group's earlier incarnation as Topanga.

purity ring.bio: Edmonton-formed electronic duo Purity Ring, made up of Megan James and Corin Roddick, blends dreamlike vocals with detailed synth-pop, future-pop and experimental electronic production.

qualité motel.bio: Sherbrooke electronic project Qualité Motel is the party-focused alter ego of Valaire, mixing DJ sets, remixes, mash-ups and original electro-pop with a rotating cast of Québec collaborators.

raahiim.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and producer RAAHiiM makes reflective contemporary R&B built around intimate slow jams, atmospheric production and candid writing.

raghav.bio: Toronto-born, Calgary-raised singer-songwriter Raghav blends R&B, pop, reggae fusion and Indian pop in a crossover catalogue that found major audiences in Canada and the United Kingdom.

rainmen.bio: Montréal Haitian-Canadian hip-hop duo Rainmen is a pioneering Québec rap group whose catalogue dates to the late 1990s and remains rooted in the city's francophone scene.

ralph.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter RALPH, born Raffaela Weyman, makes polished synth-pop, disco and smooth soul shaped by nostalgic influences and contemporary pop production.

rascalz.bio: Vancouver hip-hop group Rascalz is a foundational force in Canadian rap, representing MCing, DJing, graffiti and breaking while helping unite the country's early hip-hop scene.

raz fresco.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-rooted rapper and producer Raz Fresco is an independent hip-hop auteur known for dense lyricism, sample-driven production and his Bakers Club catalogue.

remy shand.bio: Winnipeg-born Canadian singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Remy Shand makes R&B and neo-soul rooted in classic Motown, soul and funk traditions.

ria mae.bio: Halifax singer-songwriter Ria Mae makes emotionally direct Canadian pop that pairs dance-floor production with introspective writing and soulful vocal melodies.

rich kidd.bio: Toronto producer, rapper, songwriter and director Rich Kidd is a versatile Canadian hip-hop figure known for his own mixtapes and production for artists including Drake, k-os and Nelly Furtado.

rochelle jordan.bio: London-born, Toronto-raised singer-songwriter Rochelle Jordan blends alternative R&B with house, UK garage, drum and bass and dance-pop in a sleek, forward-looking electronic soul sound.

roy woods.bio: Brampton-born singer, rapper and songwriter Roy Woods moves between atmospheric R&B, hip-hop, dancehall and pop in a genre-fluid catalogue released through OVO Sound.

ruth b..bio: Edmonton-born singer-songwriter Ruth B. makes piano-led alternative pop and R&B, rising from short-form social media performances into a globally streamed Canadian songwriting career.
